data.long_meaning: Shalini is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Shalini’ which means ‘the one who has the power to captivate or hold the attention of someone’. Shalini is believed to have the power to attract and retain love, and is often invoked for enhancing one’s charisma and allure.
